data.title: South Korea football team seeks win over Qatar in final 2026 friendly
data.content:
Korea never led in that loss — their first against Saudi Arabia since 2005 — and missed a slew of opportunities in the second half that would have at least gotten them a draw. After the match, Robert Moreno, caretaker manager for Korea, said the team had to improve “in every aspect.” [...] Tuesday's match is Moreno's sixth and likely his last one for Korea. The Spanish tactician was hired in early September to replace Hong Myung-bo, who had resigned at the end of June in light of an early World Cup exit. Instead of rushing to find a successor to Hong, the Korea Football Association (KFA) brought in Moreno on a two-month contract for the six friendlies from September to November and bought some time in its search for a full-time bench boss for the Asian Football Confederation [...] Under Moreno, the Korean players have not been fast or precise enough with their buildup plays, and they have been inefficient with their pressing. It will bear watching if the team will have made any improvement in those areas, or if Moreno, who has stuck with a 4-4-2 formation, will make any tactical changes.

data.title: South Korea to Play Final A-Match of the Year Against Qatar on Nov. 17... 'Must Change to Survive!'
data.content: Now, as they prepare for the second match of their two-match away series in November and the final A-match of 2026, a resounding victory backed by "efficient pressing and precise set pieces" is desperately needed for the Taegeuk Warriors, if only to win back the coldly chilled hearts of their fans. [...] South Korean national football team players, including Son Heung-min (from right), Hwang In-beom, and Hwang Hee-chan, undergo recovery training at Qatar University in Doha, Qatar, on Nov. 14. (Photo: Yonhap News) [...] Following their elimination from the group stage of the 2026 North and Central America World Cup and the dismantling of the Hong Myung-bo squad, South Korean football brought in Spanish-born coach Moreno as an interim head coach to helm four A-matches in September and October, along with two A-matches in November.

data.content:
- New Player Career mode: create your footballer and build a full career from lower divisions to the biggest clubs.
- Earn your place: Substitute → Rotation → Starter → Star → Captain.
- More than 150 career situations with managers, teammates, fans, transfers, injuries and interviews.
- Live match rating, personal objectives, bench starts, suspensions and tactical instructions.
- Train, manage your money and decide your future. [...] When an incident needs checking — a questionable goal, a possible penalty or a red card — you'll be invited to take part in the VAR review. Every entry in the referee match report now shows the team badge.

2026-27 squads updated after the summer transfer deadline. [...] - New playable TV Director role! Control 15 stadium cameras, choose live shots, fly the drone and spidercam, cover interviews and earn a broadcast rating.
